title: Gaza fishermen stay afloat with dinghies made from doorframes
content: Gaza fishermen stay afloat with dinghies made from doorframes Gaza fishermen stay afloat with dinghies made from doorframes Fishermen in Gaza are using dinghies made of reclaimed fiberglass, wood, and doorframes salvaged from rubble left by Israeli airstrikes to help revive the territory’s struggling fishing industry amid material shortages. Published On 6 Jun 2026
